name: ZCH_DATA_MGMT_SNAPSHOTS
description: Stores a snapshot of a member within a data set. If member data is stored outside the set, the snapshot content is captured by resolving the record ID of the member using the REST resource of the corresponding object. Alternatively, member data can be stored as part of the set by uploading the snapshot content when the member is added to the set.

columns.name: DATA_MGMT_SNAPSHOT_ID
columns.description: Identifies this snapshot within the data set

columns.name: DATA_MGMT_MEMBER_ID
columns.description: Member of which the snapshot was taken

columns.name: DATA_SET_UUID
columns.description: Data set which contains this snapshot, denormed from DATA_SET_UUID in ZCH_DATA_MGMT_MEMBERS

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the member record in the registry DB

columns.name: RECORD_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Update date of the member record in the registry DB

columns.name: RECORD_VERSION
columns.description: Version of the member record in the registry DB

columns.name: SNAPSHOT_CONTENT
columns.description: Content of this snapshot stored inline

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.
